notes.title: New update is out! Version 1.4.6
notes.notes:
New update is out! Version 1.4.6

[b]What's New?[/b]
•Lucky Spin is back!!
•You can now obtain ticket item by leveling up (10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80...)
•You can now earn EXP in SinglePlayer
•Rank Match will start on 03/23/2023
•New Item Dream Part "Order of Chronicles"
